data.title: Continental-scale mapping of Antarctic supraglacial hydrology using machine learning parquet file

parquet:columns.name: geometry
parquet:columns.description: Polygon delineating a region assigned to the raster class identified by class_id, such as open meltwater or slush. Coordinates in the supplied example are WGS 84 longitude and latitude. Geometry may be null for records representing periods with no mapped open meltwater or slush.

parquet:columns.name: source_file
parquet:columns.description: Filename or filename stem of the source classification raster. The naming pattern encodes the region, Antarctic melt season and month. For example, SGH_Abbot_20162017_Dec identifies supraglacial hydrology for the Abbot region in December 2016, within the 2016–2017 melt season.

parquet:columns.name: source_path
parquet:columns.description: Path locating the source classification raster within the input directory structure or dataset archive. Preserves the connection between each output record and its original raster.

parquet:columns.name: raster_width
parquet:columns.description: Number of pixel columns in the source raster from which the record was generated.

parquet:columns.name: raster_height
parquet:columns.description: Number of pixel rows in the source raster from which the record was generated.

parquet:columns.name: raster_transform
parquet:columns.description: Affine transformation coefficients mapping raster column and row coordinates to spatial coordinates in raster_crs. Translation terms use CRS coordinate units, while scale and rotation terms use CRS coordinate units per pixel.

parquet:columns.name: raster_crs
parquet:columns.description: Coordinate reference system of the source raster, represented as Well-Known Text.

parquet:columns.name: raster_dtype
parquet:columns.description: Numeric storage type of the source raster pixel values.

parquet:columns.name: raster_nodata
parquet:columns.description: Pixel value explicitly designated as NoData in the source raster metadata. A null value indicates that no NoData value was declared; it does not establish whether every raster cell contains valid data.

parquet:columns.name: raster_fill_value
parquet:columns.description: The value used to fill masked or otherwise unassigned cells during raster processing or export. The supplied value is 0, which matches the background classification code.

parquet:columns.name: class_id
parquet:columns.description: Classification code associated with the polygonrecord: 0 = background; 1 = open meltwater, including lakes, streams and other open-water features; 2 = slush.

parquet:columns.name: class_label
parquet:columns.description: Text label corresponding to class_id. In the supplied naming scheme, class_0 represents background, class_1 represents open meltwater, and class_2 represents slush.

parquet:columns.name: has_observation
parquet:columns.description: Indicates whether open meltwater or slush was mapped for the source region and period. True means that class 1 and/or class 2 is present. False means that neither class 1 nor class 2 is present during that period.
